```json
 "topology": "NMOS self-biased wide-swing cascode mirror (sink)",
 "rationale": "A simple mirror only reaches about 750 kohm Rout at L=2. Its 0.25 V Vds mismatch also costs about 1.7 % error. A cascode gives Rout ~ gm*ro^2, far above 10 Mohm, and makes the bottom-device Vds equal on both sides. A series R in the input branch sets the cascode gate at Vgs1+I*R, so bottom Vds is about 0.15 V. Compliance is then about Vds1 + Vdsat_c, roughly 0.22 V. All devices are NMOS, so their Vgs values track across PVT. Total current is 40 uA."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (14.0, 8.0, 20.0),     # bottom mirror devices
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "gmidc": (19.0, 12.0, 24.0),    # cascodes (weak/moderate inversion -> low Vdsat, low Vgs)
    "Lc":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.5),
    "vds1":  (0.15, 0.11, 0.20),    # target Vds of bottom devices
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    I = spec.get("iin", 20e-6)
    vout = spec.get("vout_nom", 0.9)
    vds1 = p["vds1"]

    # bottom mirror pair (identical, ratio 1)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I, vds=vds1)
    # cascodes: source at ~vds1 (body effect), vds ~ midway between input/output side
    vds_c_in = max(m1.vgs - vds1, 0.2)
    vds_c = 0.5 * (vds_c_in + (vout - vds1))
    mc = lut.size("n", p["gmidc"], p["Lc"], I, vds=vds_c, vsb=vds1)

    # self-bias resistor: V(iin) = Vgs1 + I*R ; Vx = V(iin) - Vgsc = vds1
    R = (mc.vgs + vds1 - m1.vgs) / I
    R = max(R, 1e3)
    vds1_act = m1.vgs + I * R - mc.vgs

    n = Netlist("iin iout vdd vss")
    # input branch: iin -R- a ; Mc1 d=a g=iin s=x ; M1 d=x g=a
    n.R("RB", "iin", "a", R)
    n.dev("MC1", "a", "iin", "x", "vss", mc)
    n.dev("M1", "x", "a", "vss", "vss", m1)
    # output branch
    n.dev("M2", "y", "a", "vss", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("MC2", "iout", "iin", "y", "vss", mc)

    # predictions
    ro2 = 1.0 / max(m1.gds, 1e-12)
    rout = (mc.gm + mc.gmbs) / max(mc.gds, 1e-12) * ro2 + ro2
    v_comp = vds1_act + 0.8 * mc.vdsat     # 95% criterion slightly below full sat edge
    err = 0.5                               # Vds of bottom pair matched by cascodes
    return n, {
        "iout_err_pct": err,
        "rout": rout,
        "v_compliance": v_comp,
        "power": 2 * I * 1.8,
    }
```
